title: Miss Sarajevo
creator: Bill Carter
description: A short documentary by Bill Carter, an American aid worker, on daily life during the siege, including a beauty contest held in 1993 whose contestants held up a banner: “Don’t let them kill us.” It inspired the U2 song.

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
creator: Michael Winterbottom
description: Based on the true story of a British television reporter who smuggled a girl out of an orphanage during the siege. The journalists in the film live and work in the Holiday Inn, as the real ones did.

title: In the Land of Blood and Honey
creator: Angelina Jolie
description: Angelina Jolie’s first film as a director, about a Bosniak woman and a Bosnian Serb officer whose relationship is caught up in the war. It was shot in English and in Bosnian, with local actors.
